qualification: Recording callback session lock inversion regression

runtime.emulator: Android 35 Google APIs ARM64, host GPU, 2048 MiB
runtime.remaining_failure: nativeVideoRecordingExportsBothSidesOfTheBrowserCall exceeded the bounded local audio queue; encoder/capture startup performance remains unqualified

diagnosis: The session held its state lock during a synchronous flow collector waiting for the audio capture monitor; the recording worker held that monitor while currentCall waited for the session lock
fix: Publish an immutable volatile capture snapshot at every call or roster mutation before delivering flows; the media callback reads call membership and warning compatibility without taking the session lock
limits: The entire capture suite did not pass; the live video worker failure remains open
Per-source media permission revocation, quiet Send restart/rekey, full cross-client Session warning delivery, physical long recording/export and production delivery remain open
